featured.rule:
### Event Rules for Participants  
* Participants must follow Event Staff instructions.  
* Participants should park at their designated slots.  
* Convoy participants must only leave the starting location when instructed to do so in an orderly (one by one) manner.
* Participants must haul a trailer during the convoy. 
* Double trailers, Triple trailers, HCT trailers and Heavy Haul configurations are prohibited.
* Cars including alternating vehicles are prohibited except for TruckersMP Event Staff assisting with the event. 
* Buses are prohibited.
* Overtaking is strictly prohibited.  
* Free roaming on the server is prohibited.
* All Other TruckersMP Rules Apply.  

### Event Rules for Event Staff  
* Event Staff can block junctions and roads approaching junctions in order to direct the convoy.  
* Event Staff can park out of bounds. Providing this is on the ground and not on top of buildings or other inappropriate places deemed unsuitable by TruckersMP Staff.  
* All Other **[TruckersMP Rules](https://truckersmp.com/rules)** Apply.

today.rule:
⚙️ Konvoy Kuralları (Rules):

Bu konvoyda tüm TruckersMP kuralları geçerlidir. 🧭
Lütfen güvenli ve keyifli bir sürüş için aşağıdaki ek kurallara da dikkat ediniz:

🚫 Sollama Yasaktır.
🚫 Cars (Arabalar) Kullanmak Yasaktır.
🚫 Scout Araçları yalnızca etkinlik yönetim ekibine aittir.
🚫 Troll, spam, ani durma veya kural ihlali yapanlar konvoydan uzaklaştırılır.
🚫 Aşırı hız yapmayın, grubun temposuna uyun.
🚫 Far ve korna spamlama yasaktır.
🚫 CB Radyo’yu gereksiz konuşmalar için kullanmayın.
✅ Takip mesafesini koruyun ve öndeki tıra dikkat edin.
✅ Etkinlik yöneticilerinin ve CC (Convoy Control) ekibinin talimatlarına uyun.

Kurallara uymayan sürücüler, etkinlikten çıkarılabilir.
Hedefimiz güvenli, düzenli ve eğlenceli bir sürüş! 🚛💨

⚙️ Convoy Rules (EN):

All TruckersMP rules apply during this event. 🧭
Please follow the additional rules below to ensure a safe and enjoyable convoy:

🚫 Overtaking is strictly forbidden.
🚫 Cars (Scout vehicles) are not allowed.
🚫 Scout vehicles are reserved only for Event Staff.
🚫 Trolling, spamming, sudden braking, or rule violations will result in removal.
🚫 Do not overspeed, follow the convoy leader’s pace.
🚫 No horn or high beam spam.
🚫 Keep CB Radio clear and avoid unnecessary chatter.
✅ Maintain safe distance from the truck ahead.
✅ Always follow Event Staff and CC (Convoy Control) instructions.

Drivers who fail to comply with these rules may be removed from the event.
Let’s enjoy a safe, respectful, and fun convoy! 🚛💨

today.name: MOVEMBER AWARNESS LTR CONVOY!
today.description:
## MOVEMBER AWARNESS LTR CONVOY! 👨💙
- Oficiální konvoj ke připomínce Movemberu a měsíce mužů!
## 

-----

![](https://i.imgur.com/Hvo81kw.png)

-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/jD3mPFj/CONVOY-RULES.png)


1. Respect the instructions on our Discord server - **Luky Transport Discord Server.**
2. Drive according to the rules and avoid accidents.
3. Follow company rules, they are of great importance.
4. Stick to the prescribed schedule and convoy plan.
5. Have your job and truck ready at the start of the convoy. (FULL FUEL)
6. The CARGO is restricted for Beverages and Coffee.
7. Only blue trucks and trailers are allowed.
8. Confirm your participation.
9. If your company has more than 5 members and you want to participate, you must reserve a slot on our Discord server - [link here.](https://discord.gg/lukytransport)
10. The convoy is mainly organized in Czech language, however we will use English.

-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/PCv3Xb9/schedule.png)

*  **19:30** - Meet at the parking slots in Mannheim.
*  **20:00**  - Departure from the Mannheim, Parking Slots.
*  **20:20**  - Passage around the city of Paris.
*  **20:45**  - Onboarding on Eurotunnel Train.
*  **20:50** - Departure from the train towards London.
*  **21:00**  - Passage around the city of Southampton.
*  **21:20**  - Passage around the city of London.
*  **21:55** - Arrival to the City of Manchester.
*  **22:00** - Final group photo and end of the convoy.



![](https://i.imgur.com/qPEhXyX.png)

![](https://i.imgur.com/EiyD0zj.png)

-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/CKRRfZ8/CJ.png)

**1. Mannheim, Transinet - Manchester, WGCC.**


-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/Kctz2JT/SLOT-RESERVATION.png)


To ride on this convoy for companies with more than 5 MEMBERS, slot registration is required.

For this, simply use the new slot feature on our [Discord server](https://discord.gg/lukytransport).

**Correct Registration Procedure:**

1. [Select your slot](https://discord.com/channels/1071510975196438528/1225995618955300874) with the code number in the room or on the convoy page.

upcoming.name: 🚚 Balkan Trucking Adventure | Valona ➜ Banja Luka
upcoming.description:
🚚 **Balkan Trucking Adventure | Vlore ➜ Banja Luka**

🇦🇱➡️🇧🇦 **From the coast of Vlore to the heart of the Balkans!**

Skull Network Italia invites you to join us for a brand-new convoy on **Euro Truck Simulator 2**!

Get your trucks ready and join us for an exciting journey through the roads of the Balkans, starting from **Vlore 🇦🇱** and heading all the way to **Banja Luka 🇧🇦**.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📅 **DATE**
**November 28th, 2026**

🕣 **MEETING TIME**
**20:30 🇮🇹**

🕤 **DEPARTURE TIME**
**21:30 🇮🇹**

📍 **STARTING LOCATION**
**Vlore 🇦🇱**

🏁 **DESTINATION**
**Banja Luka 🇧🇦**

🚛 **CARGO**
**Free choice** — all types of cargo are allowed, **excluding heavy/oversized cargo**.

👑 **ORGANIZER**
**Skull Network Italia**

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🔥 **ONE JOURNEY, ONE ROAD, ONE CONVOY!**

Whether you're a veteran of the virtual roads or a new participant, get your truck ready and join us for an evening full of **trucking, friendship and fun**.

From the Albanian coast all the way to Banja Luka, we'll have plenty of kilometers ahead of us, beautiful Balkan landscapes and, most importantly, a convoy to enjoy together. 🌍🚛

🖤 **Skull Network Italia is waiting for you!**

**Fuel up. Check your truck. Start your engine.**

🏁 **The road to Banja Luka starts in Vlore.**
